About.title: About
About.biographyP1: I am a full-stack developer based in Brazil with over 4 years of experience building scalable web and mobile applications. I specialize in the JavaScript ecosystem (Node.js, React, and TypeScript), alongside hands-on experience with cloud and database technologies like AWS and PostgreSQL.
About.biographyP2: Beyond the technical sphere, I am a husband and father, passionate about music and nature. I strive to foster a collaborative and positive work environment. I strongly value teamwork, assertive communication, and delivering solutions that drive real business impact.
About.biographyP3: Whether you're looking to discuss a new professional opportunity or simply exchange ideas about technology and innovation, feel free to reach out!

invenzi.jobDescription: Development and maintenance of a multi-language access control platform. Led complex hardware integrations and implemented customized business rules per location, alongside developing new features, strategic refactoring, and driving continuous product improvement.

w3lcome.jobDescription: Created new microservices and features for a multi-language platform focused on visit and reservation management. Actively contributed to maintaining integrations, optimizing code architecture, and ensuring system stability.

pontuax.jobDescription: Developed a loyalty and points product for fuel supply, prioritizing high-criticality real-time processing. Conducted system analyses, feature development, and performance-oriented refactoring to improve application scalability.

Policy.title: Privacy Policy & Terms of Service
Policy.introPart1: This page outlines the terms and policies regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information when you use this portfolio website, located at
Policy.infoCollectDesc: To provide an interactive experience, specifically the ability to leave comments or likes on projects, we collect the following information:
Policy.infoGoogle: Information you provide via Google OAuth: When you choose to log in using your Google account to leave a comment, we receive your Name, Email Address, and Profile Picture from Google.
Policy.infoDirect: Information you provide directly: When you choose to log in using Email and Password, we collect the provided Email Address. You may voluntarily provide a display name and a profile picture of your choice to be shown alongside your comments.
Policy.infoCollectEnd: We only ask for personal information when we truly need it to provide a service to you. We collect it by fair and lawful means, with your knowledge and consent.
Policy.howWeUseDesc: The information we collect is used for the following purposes:
Policy.useDisplay: To Display Your Comments: Your Name (as provided by Google) will be displayed publicly next to the comments you post (the displayed name may be changed on profile section).
Policy.useAuth: For Authentication: Your Email Address is used solely to identify you as a unique user within our system (managed by Supabase Auth). Your email address is never displayed publicly or shared with any third parties.
Policy.dataSecDesc1: Your information (name and email) is stored securely in our database, hosted by
Policy.dataSecDesc2: . We take commercially acceptable measures to protect your information from loss, theft, and unauthorized access. We do not share any personally identifying information publicly or with third parties, except when required to by law.
Policy.yourRightsDesc: You are free to refuse our request for your personal information, with the understanding that we may be unable to provide you with some of your desired services (such as leaving named comments). You can also request the deletion of your account and associated comments at any time by contacting us.
Policy.userConductDesc: You are solely responsible for the content of your comments. By posting comments on this website, you agree not to post any material that is:
Policy.conductSpam: Spam, advertising, or any form of commercial solicitation.
Policy.conductDefamatory: Defamatory, abusive, harassing, threatening, or an invasion of a right of privacy of another person.
Policy.conductHateful: Hateful, racially, or otherwise biased or offensive.
Policy.conductReserve: We reserve the right to remove any comments that violate these terms without prior notice.
Policy.ipDesc: All content included on this site, such as text, graphics, logos, and software, is the property of Gustavo Sant'Anna and protected by international copyright laws. The projects displayed are for showcase purposes.
Policy.disclaimerDesc: This website and its contents are provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. We do not guarantee that the site will be available at all times or that it will be free of errors.
Policy.limitationDesc: In no event shall Gustavo Sant'Anna be liable for any damages arising out of the use or inability to use the materials on this website.
Policy.contactDesc: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our Terms of Service, please contact us at:
